_help: Each achievement unlocks once per tier when its metric reaches `at`.
Add your own by copying an entry. Metrics you can use:
sessionDays        days you started at least one session
greenDays          days with at least one passing test run
greenRuns          passing test runs in total
redRuns            failing test runs in total
cleanStreak        sessions in a row (finished) without a failing test
longestSessionMin  longest session in minutes (a gap of 30+ min starts a new one)
nightOwlDays       days you worked between 02:00 and 05:00
projectsThisWeek   different projects worked in over the last 7 days
comebacks          returns to a project untouched for 30+ days
phoenixes          sessions where tests went from failing to passing
portedModules      modules whose status in PORT.md became 'verified'
maxCompactions     most compactions survived in one session
tagsCreated        git tags / releases created
tasksDone          tasks completed (TaskCompleted)
turnsDone          turns Claude finished (Stop)
prompts            prompts sent
filesEdited        file edits
sessions           sessions started
dayStreak          current days-in-a-row streak (any project)
installed          1 once this system is installed
